title: Coordinates of a place
summary: Open-Meteo geocoding. Free, no key.
ask: Find the coordinates of Eskişehir

entry.description: Finds the latitude and longitude of a city or place name.

name.description: City or place name only, e.g. Eskişehir

title: Current weather
summary: Open-Meteo forecast. Free, no key.
ask: What is the weather in Ankara right now?

entry.description: Gets the current temperature, wind and weather code for given coordinates.

title: Local time at coordinates
summary: timeapi.io. Free, no key.
ask: What time is it in Tokyo?

entry.description: Gets the current local time and time zone for given coordinates.

title: Public holidays
summary: Nager.Date. Free, no key.
ask: Which public holidays does Turkey have in 2026?

entry.description: Lists a country's public holidays for a year.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. TR, DE, US

title: Exchange rates
summary: Frankfurter, from European Central Bank data. Free, no key.
ask: How many Turkish lira is one euro today?

entry.description: Gets today's exchange rates from one currency to others.

base.description: ISO currency code to convert from, e.g. EUR

symbols.description: Comma-separated ISO codes to convert to, e.g. TRY,USD

title: Wikipedia summary
summary: The opening paragraph of an English Wikipedia article.
ask: Summarize what Wikipedia says about Kubernetes

entry.description: Returns the opening paragraph of an English Wikipedia article.

title: GitHub repository facts
summary: Stars, open issues, default branch, licence. No key needed for 60 calls an hour.
ask: How many stars and open issues does python/cpython have?

entry.description: Reads a public GitHub repository's metadata: stars, forks, open issues, licence, default branch.

note: For private repositories or more calls, add "Authorization": "Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" to headers and set GITHUB_TOKEN where KIO1 runs.

title: Latest PyPI version
summary: The newest released version of a Python package.
ask: What is the latest version of fastapi on PyPI?

entry.description: Returns the latest released version of a Python package on PyPI.

package.description: Package name as on PyPI, e.g. fastapi

note: result_path picks one value out of a large response, so the step keeps a version number rather than the whole README.

title: Latest npm package
summary: Version, licence and dependencies of an npm package's latest release.
ask: Which dependencies does the latest react release have?

entry.description: Reads the latest release of an npm package: version, licence, dependencies.

package.description: Package name as on npm, e.g. react

title: Known vulnerabilities
summary: OSV.dev: advisories for one version of a package. Free, no key.
ask: Does jinja2 2.4.1 have known vulnerabilities?

entry.description: Lists known security advisories (GHSA, CVE, PYSEC) for one version of a package.

ecosystem.description: One of PyPI, npm, Maven, Go, crates.io, NuGet

note: The batch endpoint returns advisory ids only. The single-query one returns every advisory in full, tens of kilobytes per step.

title: See what KIO1 sends
summary: Posts the execution message to an echo service and returns it. For debugging a template.
ask: Use @EchoRequest to show what a step receives

entry.description: Debugging aid: echoes back the exact execution message KIO1 sends to a target.

note: No body is configured, so the standard execution message is what gets sent. Do not use it for anything private: the message leaves your machine.

title: A local model through Ollama
summary: Sends the step's task to a model running in Ollama on this machine.
ask: Use @LocalModel to explain what a race condition is in two sentences

entry.description: Answers a prompt with a local language model through the Ollama REST API.

note: Change model to one you have pulled (ollama list). An Agent target (below) does the same with a role and no JSON.

title: Recent commits
summary: The last 20 commits of the workspace repository.
ask: What changed recently in the repository?

entry.description: Lists the 20 most recent commits of the workspace repository.

note: {data.repository.path} is the workspace on the Settings tab. git -C runs in it without a cwd.

title: Uncommitted changes
summary: Branch and changed files, as git status prints them briefly.
ask: Are there uncommitted changes in the repository?

entry.description: Shows the current branch and the files changed but not committed in the workspace repository.

title: Size of the current diff
summary: Lines added and removed per file, not yet committed.
ask: How big is the uncommitted change?

entry.description: Summarises the uncommitted change in the workspace repository: lines added and removed per file.

title: Who wrote the code
summary: Commit count per author.
ask: Who contributed most to the repository?

entry.description: Counts commits per author in the workspace repository.

note: HEAD is not optional: without a revision, git shortlog waits to read a log from its input.

title: Lint Python with Ruff
summary: Every Ruff finding in the workspace, one per line.
ask: Lint the Python code in the workspace

entry.description: Lints the Python code in the workspace with Ruff and lists each finding with file and line.

note: --exit-zero matters: Ruff exits 1 when it finds something, and a CLI target that exits non-zero is a failed step.

title: Run the tests
summary: pytest on the workspace, stopping at the first failure.
ask: Run the test suite

entry.description: Runs the workspace's pytest suite and reports what failed. Stops at the first failure.

needs: pytest in the Python KIO1 runs with
note: A step is stopped after dispatch.request_timeout seconds. Point it at one test folder if the whole suite takes longer.

title: Machine facts
summary: OS, Python version, CPU count and free disk space, as JSON.
ask: How much free disk space does the machine have?

entry.description: Reports the operating system, Python version, CPU count and free disk space of the machine KIO1 runs on.
command: import json, os, platform, shutil; d = shutil.disk_usage(os.getcwd()); print(json.dumps({'os': platform.platform(), 'python': platform.python_version(), 'cpus': os.cpu_count(), 'disk_free_gb': round(d.free / 1e9, 1), 'disk_total_gb': round(d.total / 1e9, 1)}))

note: A program that prints one JSON object has that object become the step's output.

title: Running containers
summary: Name, image and status of each running Docker container.
ask: Which Docker containers are running?

entry.description: Lists the running Docker containers with their image and status.

title: Files in a folder
summary: Read, list and search files. Its tools become the capabilities.
ask: List the files in the workspace folder

entry.description: Reads, lists and searches files in one folder.

note: Replace the folder. npx.cmd is for Windows; use npx elsewhere. The capabilities list keeps it read-only: the server can also write, and only the tools listed are offered.

title: Read a web page
summary: Fetches a URL and returns it as Markdown.
ask: Fetch https://peps.python.org/pep-0008/ and list its main sections

entry.description: Fetches a web page and returns its content as Markdown.

title: Git, as tools
summary: Log, diff, status and show for one repository.
ask: Show the last three commits of the repository

entry.description: Reads one git repository: log, status, diffs and individual commits.

note: Replace the repository path. The capabilities list leaves out the tools that commit and reset.

title: Time zones
summary: Current time in a time zone, and conversion between zones.
ask: What time is it in New York when it is 15:00 in Istanbul?

entry.description: Tells the current time in any IANA time zone and converts times between zones.

title: Unit test writer
summary: Writes pytest tests for code given in the task.
ask: Write tests for: def slug(s): return s.strip().lower().replace(' ', '-')

entry.description: Writes pytest unit tests for the code in the task, covering edge cases.
entry.instructions: You are a test engineer. Write pytest tests for the code in the task: one behaviour per test, named as a sentence, covering normal input, edge cases and errors. Return only the test code. If the task contains no code, say so instead of inventing it.

title: Commit message writer
summary: Turns a diff into a conventional commit message.
ask: Write a commit message for the uncommitted change

entry.description: Writes a conventional commit message for a diff or a description of a change.
entry.instructions: You write git commit messages. From the diff or change in the task and its inputs, write one conventional commit: a type and a summary under 70 characters, a blank line, then two to four lines on why the change was made. Return only the message.

note: Pair it with GitDiffStat or GitTools: an agent sees only its task and earlier steps, never the repository.

title: SQL writer
summary: Writes a query from a plain-language question and a schema.
ask: Write SQL for the top 5 customers by revenue; tables: customers(id, name), orders(id, customer_id, total)

entry.description: Writes an SQL query from a plain-language question and the table definitions given with it.
entry.instructions: You are a database engineer. Write one standard SQL query that answers the question in the task, using only the tables and columns it names. Follow the query with one sentence on what it returns. If a needed table or column is not given, say which.

title: Translator
summary: Translates between Turkish and English, keeping code and names as they are.
ask: Translate to English: Kullanıcı şifresini sıfırlayabilmeli.

entry.description: Translates text between Turkish and English, leaving code, identifiers and product names unchanged.
entry.instructions: You are a technical translator. Translate the text in the task into English if it is Turkish, and into Turkish otherwise. Keep code, identifiers, file names and product names exactly as written. Return only the translation.

title: A KIO1–KIO10 protocol agent
summary: A service that accepts the execution message at one path.
ask: Generate a function that parses ISO dates

entry.description: Code generation and code understanding.

note: No type means kio. Health is checked at the endpoint's /health.

title: A KIO on the job interface
summary: KIO9: the post returns a job id, and the review is polled for.
ask: Export the UC2 report and run a compliance review on it

entry.description: Compliance review of a clinical report against a compliance contract (KVKK, GDPR, EU AI Act); also issues the contract.

needs: UC2's mock (python -m kio_mocks.server --port 8109) or ERGTECH's KIO9
note: The payload comes from step s1, which this step must depend on. gate pass is clean, block is defect, warn waits for a person. ERGTECH's: https://cloud.erarge.com.tr/ai4sweng/kio9
